statements.speaker: Ben Carter (Elva)
statements.quote: We're exploring whether Elva's integration could screen NUSD recipient wallets on Solana for your Australian launch.

statements.speaker: Hannah Moore (Elva)
statements.quote: We can target your 15 January 2027 go-live, provided Coral Pay gives us sandbox and testnet access by 15 December 2026.

statements.speaker: Elva (questionnaire response)
statements.quote: Elva will deploy Coral Pay's production environment on Microsoft Azure in the Australia East region.

statements.quote: Elva will screen the recipient wallet of every NUSD payout on Solana through its pre-built analytics integration before release.

statements.quote: The payout ledger connector will handle up to 12,000 payouts per day at launch.

statements.quote: Elva's sanctions screening API will screen up to 25,000 payer and beneficiary names per day.

statements.quote: Payout exceptions will be managed in Elva's case management workspace.
